lines.text: Hehe! Hehehe! *Gasp, cough, cough*
The leader said I'm acting like a dog. That's a compliment, right?
I had a great day. I ate a lot, and got to fire a whole lotta artillery.
If anyone is giving you a hard time, let me know and I'll bite their heads off!
Hehehe! It's always a blast hanging out with you, Commander.
I'll wait for you like a faithful guard dog. Aren't I awesome?
Commander... why aren't you doing anything? I'm bored stiff!
Come and play with me, Commander, or I'll give you a chomp. Hehe.
Captain asked me to take you to Trandy Bar. No, was it Trendy Bar? Who cares. Let's go!

I've never been anywhere as great as this! Tasty food and fun abound!
Can I stay here as long as I like?
What if I shoot here? Rat-tat-tat! HAHAHA!
Hehehe! I'll rip out the throats of all your enemies!
I'm so much stronger!
Look! I've gotten my teeth sharpened!
Whose throat will my fangs sink into?
Is this for me? Really?
You are so nice, Commander!
All these are mine! Am I dreaming?

Commander, you're awesome!
But Crow is my owner. If she wasn't, I'd be by your side!

Can we spend every day together?
I'd love that!
Hehe! You're the only one I won't bite, that's the truth!
Are we going to play? Where at?
You rang?
I'll be there ASAP!
Pleasure incoming!
I'm ready to bite down and never let go!
Hehehe! Here it comes... Here it is!
Compliment me when I take them down!
Hehehe! I had a blast!
Gotta reload, and advance!
Yeeehawww! So exciting!
Commander!
Tear them apart! HAHAHAHAHAHA!
Hehehehe! Fire at will!
I got it!
Dead!
Hehehehe!
*Coughing*
Owww!
Ah!
Arghhh... I've had enough, no more combat for now.
I won, Commander! Gimme some treats!
